Driving School Transportation into the Future

Get every student to school on time. HopSkipDrive is a leader in supplemental student transportation, offering access to safe, reliable rides as well as RouteWise AI™,  the world’s first student transportation intelligence platform, all powered by transformative technology.

SchoolsFamilies

How We Help

HopSkipDrive solves complex transportation challenges where there is a heightened need for safety, equity, and care.

Supplemental Transportation

We fill school transportation gaps. Our network of highly vetted CareDrivers in small vehicles supplements existing services like yellow buses, providing support when and where schools and riders need it most.

LEARN MORE

RouteWise AI™

Customized, data-driven routing plans tailored to school district requirements, priorities, and constraints.

LEARN MORE

The HopSkipDrive Difference

Technology-powered solutions for safe, dependable, and individually tailored student transportation.

Reliable Rides When You Need Them

HopSkipDrive's flexible network of vetted caregivers in small vehicles enables ride bookings with just six hours' notice.

Technology to Equip School Districts with New Options

Solve for bus driver shortages, bell time policy changes, and more with HopSkipDrive’s intuitive platform and AI-powered routing software.

We Always Put Safety First

Safety is in our DNA. From our 15-point CareDriver certification to cutting-edge Safe Ride Technology, HopSkipDrive is the industry leader in safety and transparency.

Who We Support

Meeting the Needs of All Students

From specialized transportation for students with unique needs, to general education and after-school programs, we connect schools and families with adaptable transportation that prioritizes safety, reliability, and convenience. 

“The easiest McKinney-Vento process compared to any other school year.”

—Cypress-Fairbanks Independent School District

Students eligible for transportation through the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act can move frequently, making it difficult to arrange transportation with a standard school bus. HopSkipDrive’s nimble network of CareDrivers can provide rides with just six hours’ notice, ensuring these students don't miss out.

READ CASE STUDY

“All the drivers are super friendly, and it’s always been a really positive experience. I was able to gain more stability, make more friends, be the old me . . . happy, smiling and excited to go to school.”

—Georgina, student

Youth in foster care often experience placement changes and instability, making consistent transportation to school and other activities a challenge. The Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA) mandates transportation for these students — and HopSkipDrive’s flexible, care-centered marketplace provides reliable rides, ensuring youth in foster care can stay connected to education, resources, and their communities.

READ CASE STUDY

“We love that CareDrivers are connected with resources on best practices in working with special needs students.”

—Prince William County Public Schools

Students with special needs often have Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) that include specialized transportation requirements. For some students, they may need consistent drivers, a rider assistant, or a wheelchair-accessible vehicle (WAV). No matter their need, HopSkipDrive offers a safe and reliable solution to help students get to school, therapy, and other appointments comfortably and on time.

READ CASE STUDY

“HopSkipDrive has helped to save travel time for our students…. Transportation is no longer a factor for missing school.”

—SIATech South Bay

Charter schools often have unique transportation needs due to varied school locations or limited bus service. HopSkipDrive’s flexible and reliable transportation solutions help charter schools expand access and opportunity for all students.

READ CASE STUDY

“I’m proud of how our team and community embraced HopSkipDrive’s innovative portfolio approach, which is now ensuring all kids in the district have safe and reliable access to a high-quality education.”

—Colorado Springs School District 11

Even general education students can benefit from HopSkipDrive’s safe and reliable transportation solutions. Whether it’s getting to and from school, extracurricular activities, or after-school appointments, our service helps students arrive on time and ready to learn, while giving parents peace of mind.

READ CASE STUDY

“A lot of kids that lack resources tend to be inconsistent with their attendance… [HopSkipDrive] allows for them to have a higher level of stability because they can depend on it.”

—Better Youth

After-school activities are essential for a child’s development, but getting them there can be a logistical puzzle. HopSkipDrive simplifies after-school transportation, arranging safe and reliable rides to sports practice, music lessons, enrichment programs, tutoring, and more.

READ CASE STUDY

“HopSkipDrive has given students like me a sense of assurance with their transportation needs. It’s allowed me to really spread my wings, in a way.”

—Chimzara, student

HopSkipDrive helps districts overcome the logistical challenges of transporting students to off-campus CTE programs. By leveraging our network of vetted CareDrivers and advanced technology, districts can accommodate varying schedules and needs — ensuring that every student has access to valuable hands-on learning opportunities.

READ CASE STUDY
